limit_order_match_processing.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_processing.checkpoint: before the zero-cost validation of the limit order match

matched_base_amount.meaning: matched base amount of the limit order match
matched_base_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost validation of the limit order match

matched_quote_amount.meaning: matched quote amount of the limit order match
matched_quote_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost validation of the limit order match

matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.meaning: the matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (bitwise AND of the two amounts is zero)
matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost validation of the limit order match

match_rejected_as_zero_cost.meaning: the legitimate limit order match is rejected as a zero-cost trade
match_rejected_as_zero_cost.checkpoint: during the zero-cost validation of the limit order match

traders_encounter_unexplained_failures.meaning: traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, encounter unexplained failures
traders_encounter_unexplained_failures.checkpoint: after the limit order matching attempt

assumptions: The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities of the limit order match at the zero-cost validation checkpoint.

unresolved.description: The report does not quote the exact zero-cost check expression or its operands, so the bitwise-disjointness precondition is represented by a grounded Boolean rather than a bitwise predicate.

limitations: The impact is potential; the impact_outcome Boolean records the reported potential outcome rather than an inevitable one.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated in the report and are not encoded.
